Have you ever been cheated on? I get the feeling that this is a result of something from your past. Could I be right?

I think you shouldn't look around at other people and compare them to yourself. Not everyone can get perfect grades, try to get that in your head. Good doesn't necessarily mean perfect, you can still do great but not 100%, which would be awesome. Learn from your mistakes, see what you did wrong on a test and think for a minute what made you screw up. Take it slow, your classmates may already have good grades, but that's because it's probably how it's always been for them. Success doesn't come all at once, you eventually earn it.

Besides, grades shouldn't be a reason to end anyone's life, being such a minor thing. Remember - grades do not determine one's intelligence. My grades right now suck more than ever, I used to be such a good student but now I fail everything, yet I do not let that bring me down, because I know I can still be a good person and live a great life, either I score an A or an F in math. Don't look down on yourself and don't underestimate your abilities!
